name: axium
description: AXIUM — Sistema Comercial Integrado (CRM + Agenda + Rotina + Tarefas + Arquivos)

scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @axium/api & npm run dev -w @axium/web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @axium/shared && npm run build -w @axium/api && npm run build -w @axium/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @axium/api && npm run lint -w @axium/web
